mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHEDULE ( scd_id, mbr_cd, scd_titl_nm, scd_cont, scd_str_dtm, scd_end_dtm, scd_rpt_set_cont, scd_del_yn ) VALUES ( #{scdId}, #{mbrCd}, #{scdTitlNm}, #{scdCont,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scdStrDtm}, #{scdEndDtm}, #{scdRptSetCont,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHEDULE SET scd_titl_nm = #{scdTitlNm}, scd_cont = #{scdCont}, scd_str_dtm = #{scdStrDtm}, scd_end_dtm = #{scdEndDtm}, scd_rpt_set_cont = #{scdRptSetCont} WHERE scd_id = #{scdId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM SCHEDULE WHERE scd_del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY scd_str_dtm DESC
